record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the pointwise-loss coefficient from 0.2 to 0.15, retaining BPR and averaging over valid positions. This smaller adjustment tests whether modestly reducing absolute-score calibration improves ranking without the larger reduction previously tested at 0.1. Preserve features, embeddings, GRU topology, readout, scoring, negative sampling, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Retain one independently trained checkpoint per category.
